name: Gmt Global Inc.
summary: GMT Global Inc. manufactures and trades metal molds, automation modules, and linear motion components. The company provides high-precision solutions, including motorized stages and alignment platforms, for applications in the semiconductor, optical communication, laser, and life sciences industries. It serves customers internationally with both standard products and custom-designed solutions based on its expertise in precision machining and motion control. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Changhua, Taiwan.
